reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I always leave pills at home and can toss a few in my gym bag. I've seen a bunch of videos on magnesium glycinate for sleep, so I'd try one box of the bisglycinate for $29.99 and see if I sleep better or get fewer cramps.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I've taken supplements that did nothing, and $30 is a lot to find out after a month.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial pack or a clear refund if I don't notice anything after the first box.
